name: Chicken Tikka
description: Smoky Pakistani chicken tikka marinated in yogurt, lemon, ginger-garlic and spices, then grilled until charred and juicy.
method: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, spices, oil and salt.
Coat the chicken thoroughly and marinate for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers or place on a grill rack.
Grill over high heat, turning regularly, until cooked through with lightly charred edges.
Rest for a few minutes and serve with mint chutney, onion and lemon.
